items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: because we made it up. Me and two more boys, Friday and Dale Coe Robert.

ctx.x: Well, we started playing it around, you know, Fairty, Louisiana, Natchez, Mississippi, Tallulah, Louisiana, different places, you know, just Kepa color-vading it, you know. So I named it. Some of the boys tried to make 44 blues out of it, so I just changed the name of it because we made it up. Me and two more boys, Friday and Dale Coe Robert. So I changed the name to Vicksburg Blues, you know, I have to.
